title: Closed-loop machine learning maps multimetallic glucose-oxidation catalysts
summary: Gaussian process regression surrogates trained on measured data guided which Au-Ir-Pt-Pd-Rh-Ru nanoparticle compositions to electrodeposit and test next. Highly active compositions lay near the Au-Pt edge, while the most poisoning-resistant were central with Rh and Pd up to 20 at%, revealing an activity versus poisoning-resistance trade-off. The loop's own experiments are the validation, without separate holdout, and only alkaline glucose oxidation was studied.
ai_technology: Gaussian process regression surrogates in closed-loop selection, with SHAP interpretation

evidence.tested: Model-proposed compositions synthesised by electrodeposition and measured electrochemically.
evidence.unknown: Full numerical results; performance outside alkaline conditions.
